mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_file (file_path, file_str_nm, file_org_nm, file_size, file_ext, file_desc, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{filePath}, #{fileStrNm}, #{fileOrgNm}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExt}, #{fileDesc}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_file WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND file_org_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
SELECT file_id, file_path, file_str_nm, file_org_nm, file_size, file_ext, file_desc, use_yn FROM t_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE file_id = #{fileId}::integer
UPDATE t_file SET use_yn = 'N', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND file_id IN ( SELECT file_id FROM r_file WHERE map_key = #{mapKey}::integer AND file_loc IN #{loc} )
mapper.select: SELECT file_id, file_path, file_str_nm, use_yn FROM t_file f WHERE (f.use_yn = 'N' AND f.upd_dt < NOW() - make_interval(days => #{retentionDays})) OR (f.use_yn = 'Y' AND f.reg_dt < NOW() - make_interval(hours => #{abandonHours}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r_file r WHERE r.file_id = f.file_id))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId}::integer

SELECT f.file_id, f.file_org_nm, f.file_ext, f.file_size, f.file_desc, r.file_loc, r.ordr FROM r_file r JOIN t_file f ON f.file_id = r.file_id AND f.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = #{mapKey}::integer AND r.file_loc = #{fileLoc} ORDER BY r.ordr, f.file_id
SELECT file_loc, map_key::TEXT AS map_key FROM r_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId}::integer
SELECT reg_id FROM t_bbs WHERE bbs_id = #{mapKey}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file SET file_desc = #{fileDesc} WHERE file_id = #{fileId}::integer
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM r_file WHERE map_key = #{mapKey}::integer AND file_loc = #{fileLoc}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO r_file (map_key, file_id, file_loc, ordr) VALUES (#{mapKey}::integer, #{fileId}::integer, #{fileLoc}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{ordr}, '')::integer, 0))
